how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DRDO DIBT Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://nats.education.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-09-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DIBT Graduate Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO DIBT Graduate Apprentice recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Sc. degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Food Science & Technology, or Life Sciences, or a BE/B.Tech degree in Polymer Science, with a First Division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Graduate Apprentice position?
faq.answer: The selected Graduate Apprentice will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/-.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the DRDO DIBT Graduate Apprentice position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post to the Centre Head, Defence Institute of Biodefence Technologies (DIBT), Mysuru. Ensure all required documents are attached.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Graduate Apprentice post at Defence Institute of Biodefence Technologies.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The Graduate Apprentice positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Defence Institute of Biodefence Technologies located?
faq.answer: The Defence Institute of Biodefence Technologies is located in Mysuru, Karnataka, with the pincode 570011.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DIBT/HRD/APPR/2026-27.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Graduate Apprentice role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves verification of credentials followed by contract execution.
